prerequisites: Project cloned from the GitHub repository
Project opened in Visual Studio Code
note: If you are a developer and intend to make changes to the application, run the application in development mode.
If you are a developer or user and only intend to use the application, run the application in production mode.

step 1.description: Open a new terminal in Visual Studio Code and navigate to the MLServices project directory.

step 2.description: Build the production Docker images without using the Docker build cache.

step 3.description: Start the application in production mode.

step 4.description: Verify that the application is running by opening the API documentation in a web browser.

step 5.description: Stop the running ML services container.

step 1.description: Open a new terminal in Visual Studio Code and navigate to the development Docker Compose directory.

step 2.description: Build the development Docker images without using the Docker build cache.

step 3.description: Start the application in development mode.

step 4.description: Verify that the application is running by opening the API documentation in a web browser.

step 5.description: Run the automated tests inside the development container.
